summary: Stage selected native mod profiles through shared archives without copy fallback.
details: Upgrade tests and twelve existing Bob/Angel and K2 native lease consumers now require verified hard links. Link failures refuse staging instead of copying dependency archives; writable settings and fixture state remain separate.

The compatibility audit defaults to Hardlink and rejects Copy/Symlink. Its MIR input must be an existing materialized ZIP; raw repository copying is retired. Matching aliases are verified, and missing or mismatched inputs fail before engine use.

Storage guidance records manifest-based profiles and affected regression selection. Historical interface and native records remain bound to their original source; no current gameplay qualification is claimed.
